notes: No cab block — running into tube amp. Confirmed rig: Jonny Greenwood used a Vox AC30TB (Essex A30, preamp-only) with Boss OD-3 (Stupor OD approximation) and Boss RE-20 Space Echo (Cosmos Echo). Since the AC30TB is a specific confirmed amp, it's modeled as an Essex A30 preamp block per AGENTS.md's rule — the chain has room under the 8-block serial-path limit so it sits on Path 1A, no parallel path needed. Mid-forward, slightly psychedelic tone with tribal, percussive character. 4-stage phaser adds swirling quality. Two snapshots: verse riff and heavy chorus.

signal_chain.notes: Approximates Boss OD-3 — mid-forward overdrive. ACTIVE in both snapshots. Chorus snapshot pushes Drive harder for more intensity.

Confirmed amp for Jonny Greenwood's Hail to the Thief-era tone. Preamp-only (no cab/power amp) — sits after the Stupor OD (per AGENTS.md convention: after distortion, before modulation) and before Script Mod Phase, EQ, delay, and reverb. Fits within the existing 8-block limit on Path 1A, so no parallel path needed. The preamp-only version of this model doesn't expose Cut, Mid, or Presence (those are power-amp/cab-stage parameters on the full Amp version) — only Drive/Bass/Treble/Master/Sag/Ch Vol/Hum are available. Chorus snapshot pushes Drive and Master slightly harder, mirroring the Stupor OD's own increase, for the thicker, more saturated section.
Slow, subtle phaser adds the swirling, slightly psychedelic quality underneath the rhythm guitar. Keep understated — should feel like movement rather than an obvious effect. ACTIVE in both snapshots.
This song lives in the mids. Low cut at 100Hz removes bass muddiness. Mid boost at 500Hz adds the thick low-mid body. Chorus snapshot gets more aggressive mid boost and tighter high cut.

Confirmed Jonny Greenwood used RE-201 Space Echo from 1995. Tempo-synced to 92 BPM. Eighth note (326ms) — 6ms off target, synced value preferred. Short, dark delay at low level adds depth without cluttering rhythm. Treble rolled off to keep repeats dark.
Room 1-style character — contained, immediate reverb not a large hall. Short decay keeps the percussive attack from getting washy.

1_verse.description: Verse riff tone. Stupor OD at Drive 5.0. Essex A30 preamp active at Drive 4.0 for AC30TB front-end character. Script Mod Phase slow and subtle. Mid boost +4dB at 500Hz. Cosmos Echo at 28% mix. Moderate reverb.

2_chorus.description: Heavy chorus tone. Stupor OD pushed to Drive 6.5, driving the Essex A30 preamp harder too (Drive 5.0, Master 7). More aggressive mid boost +5dB. Tighter high cut. Delay pulls back to 18% mix so it doesn't clutter the heavier texture. Shorter, drier reverb keeps punch.

playing_notes.pickup_notes: Bridge pickup throughout — maximum attack and definition
playing_notes.technique: Very deliberate and percussive strumming. Let the compressor and OD do the work, don't over-pick.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Snapshot 1 for verses. Snapshot 2 for chorus sections where the arrangement thickens.
